topics.title: Political developments in Armenia
topics.text: Prime Minister Pashinyan concluded a tour of Yerevan's Ajapnyak district to discuss residents' concerns. He also proposed using AI to assess urban infrastructure repair needs and proposed an urban development project in the same district. Additionally, Pashinyan urged extracurricular education providers to inform parents about tax reimbursements.
